recognize_zh: 空泡化巨噬細胞邊緣有數個小橢圓形酵母菌，具透亮暈圈與偏心紫色染色質，旁邊還有游離的相同菌體；周圍有中性球系列細胞，符合 Histoplasma capsulatum 感染。
features: Vacuolated macrophages with folded nuclei and foamy cytoplasm
Small oval yeasts with clear halos and eccentric chromatin at the edge of a macrophage
Extracellular yeast forms near the red cells, likely released by smearing
Adjacent neutrophil-lineage cells (band/metamyelocyte) and vacuolated monocytoid cells
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several vacuolated macrophages and granulocytic cells. Clustered at the edge of one macrophage and extending into the adjacent background are several small, uniform oval yeast forms with clear halos and eccentric chromatin, some extracellular, likely released from ruptured macrophage cytoplasm. No hyphae or thick capsules are present. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection; confirmatory GMS stain, antigen assay or culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Candida glabrata yeasts are similar in size but lack the Wright-stain halo, and species identification requires culture.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucoid capsule and narrow-based budding.
Amastigotes have a kinetoplast adjacent to the nucleus and no halo.
Precipitate and platelets are irregular granular particles without a refractile wall, halo and internal crescentic chromatin.
